zh.title: Textron Aviation交付第500架Cessna CJ4飛機
zh.summary: Textron交付第500架CJ4飛機，並預計年內取得Gen3型號認證
body: Textron Aviation 於 2026 年 8 月 17 日宣布，旗下子公司塞斯納（Cessna）已正式交付第 500 架 Cessna Citation CJ4 系列飛機。此一里程碑是透過向菲律賓的一位客戶交付一架 Citation CJ4 Gen2 飛機所達成，這標誌著該製造商在輕型商務噴射機項目上的重要進展。
Citation CJ4 系列屬於輕型行政噴射機家族，該項目最初於 2006 年啟動，並於 2008 年完成首飛，此後已成為最暢銷的私人噴射機系列之一。目前，Textron Aviation 每年大約交付 30 架 CJ4 飛機。
本次第 500 架飛機的交付，距離該公司於 2023 年 4 月交付第 400 架 Cessna CJ4 僅過去三年多。當時的第 400 架里程碑飛機是交付給美國的工業集團 Koch Holdings。
Textron Aviation 銷售與行銷資深副總裁 Lannie O’Bannion 在宣布第 500 架飛機交付的新聞稿中表示，Citation CJ4 在過去十多年中一直樹立了同類別的標準。他強調，透過 Citation CJ4 Gen2 以及即將推出的 Citation CJ4 Gen3，公司將繼續投資於客戶最重視的創新、技術與功能。
目前，該製造商正積極開發並進行下一代車型 Citation CJ4 Gen3 的飛行測試。這款即將推出的機型是 Citation CJ4 系列中最新且最大的版本，承接了先前的 CJ4 基礎型和 Gen2 版本。Gen3 機型預計可搭載最多九名乘客與兩名飛行員，並預期將在 2026 年年底前獲得美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）頒發的型號合格證。
即將面世的 Citation CJ4 Gen3 將配備全新的 Garmin G3000 PRIME 航電系統以及 Garmin 緊急自動著陸安全系統。根據 AeroTime 過去的歷史紀錄，Citation CJ4 Gen3 的原型機已於 2024 年 10 月完成了首次飛行，這是 Textron Aviation 輕型噴射機現代化飛行測試計劃的一部分。

en.title: Textron Aviation Delivers 500th Cessna Citation CJ4 Series Aircraft
en.summary: Textron Aviation delivers its 500th Cessna Citation CJ4 series business jet to a customer in the Philippines.
body: Textron Aviation announced on August 17, 2026, that its subsidiary company Cessna has officially delivered the 500th business jet in the Cessna Citation CJ4 series. This milestone delivery was accomplished with the handover of a Citation CJ4 Gen2 aircraft to an unnamed customer based in the Philippines, marking a significant achievement for the manufacturer's light jet program.

The Cessna Citation CJ4 series belongs to a prominent family of light executive jets. The program was originally launched in 2006 and completed its maiden flight in 2008, eventually becoming one of the best-selling families of private business jets. At present, Textron Aviation maintains a production and delivery rate of approximately 30 Citation CJ4 aircraft per year.

This 500th delivery occurs slightly more than three years after the manufacturer celebrated its 400th Cessna Citation CJ4 delivery back in April 2023. That previous milestone business jet was delivered to Koch Holdings, an industrial conglomerate based in the United States.

Lannie O’Bannion, the Senior Vice President for Sales and Marketing at Textron Aviation, stated in a press release that the Citation CJ4 has set the industry standard in its class for over a decade. He emphasized that with the current Citation CJ4 Gen2 and the upcoming Citation CJ4 Gen3, the company continues to invest in innovation, technology, and the capabilities most valued by their customers.

The manufacturer is already actively developing and flight testing the next iteration of the series, the Citation CJ4 Gen3. This upcoming model represents the latest and largest version of the Citation CJ4 series, succeeding the original CJ4 base model and the Gen2 version. Designed to carry up to nine passengers and two pilots, the Gen3 model is expected to secure its type certificate from the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) before the end of 2026.

The upcoming Citation CJ4 Gen3 is set to introduce several advanced cockpit and safety features, including the new Garmin G3000 PRIME avionics suite along with the Garmin Emergency Autoland safety system. According to verified aviation history records, the prototype for the Citation CJ4 Gen3 conducted its very first flight back in October 2024, as part of Textron Aviation's broader light jet modernization flight-test campaign.

zh.title: 首批F16Vblk70戰機近期將飛返台灣志航基地
zh.summary: 軍方透露首批全新F-16V戰機近期返台；美商已採雙班制全力趕工
body: 台灣空軍向美國採購的首批F-16V（blk70）戰機預計將於近期自美國飛返台灣，並降落於台東的空軍志航基地。根據軍方人士於2026年8月18日透露的消息，雖然首批戰機的返台準備工作正在進行中，但確切的航渡細節與抵台時間仍需由美方最終決定，目前的具體時程尚未正式確認。
本次採購為空軍代號「鳳翔專案」的對美軍購計畫，總計籌購66架全新的F-16V（blk70）型戰機。該專案斥資新台幣2472億2883萬元，規劃為自民國109年至115年的持續性預算。雖然原定計畫是在今年內將這批戰機全數飛返台灣，但受到生產線搬遷重啟以及全球供應鏈中斷等複雜因素的影響，導致交機進度稍有延宕。為此，美方生產商目前已採取2班制、每日20小時全力趕工，以加速交付進度。
與此同時，台灣空軍先前推動的另一項「鳳展專案」已全數執行完畢。該專案由美商洛克希德馬丁與漢翔合作，將現役的140架F-16A/B型戰機，全面升級為現有的F-16V（blk20）標準，該升級計畫已在民國112年12月全數完成，順利提升空軍現役主戰機隊的作戰效能。
根據空軍先前的說明，新型的F-16V（blk70）戰機除了具備推力變大、機身結構優化、航程增加（配備適型油箱）等優勢外，還具備強大的視距外作戰能力及部分匿蹤特性。此外，該型戰機更搭載了先進的主動電子掃描陣列（AESA）雷達，具備對空搜索、目標追蹤、武器導控、電子作戰以及通訊等多種高度整合的功能。

en.title: First Batch of F-16V blk70 Fighters to Fly Back to Taiwan in the Near Future
en.summary: Military sources state the first F-16V blk70 fighter jets will fly to Taiwan in the near future.
body: The first batch of F-16V (blk70) fighter jets purchased by the Taiwan Air Force from the United States is scheduled to fly back to Taiwan in the near future and land at Zhihang Air Base in Taitung. According to military sources speaking on August 18, 2026, while preparations are underway, the exact routing details and final arrival schedule are still to be determined by the United States, and the specific timeline has not yet been confirmed.

This procurement program, code-named Project "Feng Xiang" (鳳翔專案), involves the acquisition of 66 brand-new F-16V (blk70) fighter jets. The air force allocated a continuous budget of NT$247,228,830,000 spanning from the year 109 to 115 (2020 to 2026) for the project. Although the original plan called for "all" 66 jets to fly back to Taiwan within this year, the schedule experienced slight delays due to complex factors including assembly line relocation, plant restarts, and supply chain disruptions. In response, the US side has implemented a two-shift, 20-hour daily work schedule to accelerate production.

This project is distinct from Project "Feng Zhan" (鳳展專案), under which the Air Force partnered with US manufacturer Lockheed Martin and Hanxiang to upgrade 140 existing F-16A/B fighter jets to the F-16V (blk20) configuration. This upgrade program was fully completed in December 112 (December 2023), successfully enhancing the capabilities of the existing fleet.

According to previous briefings by the Air Force, the new F-16V (blk70) features greater engine thrust, an optimized airframe structure, and an extended operational range through the use of conformal fuel tanks. Additionally, the aircraft offers beyond-visual-range combat capabilities and partial stealth characteristics. It is also equipped with an Active Electronically Scanned Array (AESA) radar, which integrates multiple capabilities including air search, tracking, weapon control, electronic warfare, and communications.
